_comment: SÜLD asset-pipeline MCP servers. Both run FULLY HEADLESS in the cloud (no laptop, no localhost-to-laptop). Run scripts/setup-cloud-tools.sh once per fresh session FIRST (installs Blender + both servers into .tools/); MCP tools are then registered on the NEXT session start. See ASSET_PIPELINE.md.

blockbench-headless._note: Upstream recommends `npx -y github:jasonjgardner/blockbench-mcp-plugin`, but codeload.github.com is egress-blocked here, so we run the git-cloned checkout with Bun instead (identical server, 23 tools).

blender-headless._note: djeada/blender-mcp-server. Use blender_python_exec / render / export tools with transport="headless" so each call spawns `blender -b` (27 tools). Do NOT use the localhost:9876 addon bridge.
